Konsa opened the scoring inside seven minutes in north London, prodding home from close range after Martin Odegaard's dangerous corner popped up and was clawed on to the crossbar by Jordan Pickford.

reasons.text: With a traditional box score stat line of 17 points, 7.7 rebounds and 4.3 assists with three stocks per game, most wouldn’t classify Barnes’ start to the season as “rough.” But one glaring stat peels the curtain back on an early trend in Barnes’ game that actually reveals that he isn’t even playing up to his full potential.

Goals from William Osula (£5.8m) and Harvey Barnes (£6.1m) secured the points, although the biggest FPL talking point came before kick-off, with Yoane Wissa (£6.1m) and Malick Thiaw (£5.0m) both benched.
The same goes for Barnes, although they’ll both be on the chopping block from Gameweek 11: GAME OF TWO HALVES It was the proverbial game of two halves at Selhurst Park.
Alex Iwobi chats after setting up Fulham's equalising goal in the 1-1 draw with Aston Villa.

But an improved second-half showing from the visitors saw them deservedly draw level when Zion Suzuki spilled Alex Iwobi’s corner over the line, before they repelled Villa’s late advances in search of a winner to ensure the spoils were shared.

Even if it plays out in Fulham’s favour the early days were bound to be rocky, but after two draws and four defeats in the Premier League , there it was: Iwobi scored the only goal in a 1-0 Fulham win, their first of 2026/27.

Fulham dominated the opening stages with some slick passages of play, though without troubling the returning Henderson in the away goal, but Kenny Tete was unfortunate to send his powerful header from an Alex Iwobi corner the wrong side of the post after quarter of an hour.
The loose ball dropped to Alex Iwobi but his effort flew off target.
Alex Iwobi (£5.4m) was the star of the show against Hull, returning an 11-point haul in Fantasy.
Iwobi’s first attacking return of the season had been coming, prior to GW7 he’d racked up nearly 2.0 expected goal involvement (xGI) without scoring or assisting.
PROMISING IWOBI STATS In another attack, Garcia set up a big chance for Alex Iwobi (£5.4m), who fired straight at Konstantinos Tzolakis (£4.7m).
